description: This file is a performance testing framework script for Git, providing functions and setup for running performance tests, managing repositories, and handling test environment configurations.

methods.name: die_if_build_dir_not_repo
methods.description: Checks if the build directory is a Git repository; exits if not.

methods.name: test_perf_do_repo_symlink_config_
methods.description: Sets Git symlinks configuration if prerequisites are met.

methods.name: test_perf_copy_repo_contents
methods.description: Copies repository contents excluding specific directories.

methods.name: test_perf_create_repo_from
methods.description: Creates a new repository from a source repository, copying objects and configurations.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Creates a repository from default source.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Creates a large repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Checks out all files in the worktree.

methods.name: test_run_perf_
methods.description: Runs a performance test with timing and environment setup.

methods.name: test_wrapper_
methods.description: Wraps a test with setup, prerequisites, and result handling.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Performs a performance test with repetitions and timing.

methods.name: test_at_end_hook_
methods.description: Aggregates and reports test results at the end.
